plan.title: Commercial Bid Submission and Portal Sync

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product for the commercial bid.
Complete the pricing sheet so the RFQ can be published.
Invite the available QA vendor audience to the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a bid.
Use the catalog's supported web supplier portal as the closest available vendor channel.
Open the published RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the commercial bid at the required price of 500.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer console to verify synchronization.
Assert that the buyer's RFQ Responses view contains the vendor's direct bid.
